name: Gamma Exposure / Dealer Gamma identifiability

coreConclusions.gammaSignMath: Long calls and long puts have positive gamma; short calls and short puts have negative gamma. Call-vs-put does not determine gamma sign.
coreConclusions.reason: TAIFEX public option-chain OI is strike/expiry specific but anonymous; dealer-class long/short option OI is aggregated and not cross-tabulated by strike and expiry. Dealers also include Futures Proprietary Merchants and Securities Dealers, not only option market makers.
coreConclusions.primaryUse: market-volatility/liquidity context before directional or stock-ranking use

optionChain.note: Use the full active-series universe needed to reconcile the same product/date/session; do not silently mix regular and after-hours rows.

taifexDirectionMapping.callDealerLongOI: buy calls => long option => positive gamma
taifexDirectionMapping.callDealerShortOI: sell calls => short option => negative gamma
taifexDirectionMapping.putDealerLongOI: sell puts => short option => negative gamma
taifexDirectionMapping.putDealerShortOI: buy puts => long option => positive gamma

modelInputs.underlyingReference: Freeze spot-index vs futures-underlying convention; never mix silently.
modelInputs.multiplier: TXO contract multiplier must be sourced from TAIFEX contract specification

unsignedGamma1PctDefinition: gamma * openInterest * contractMultiplier * underlying^2 * 0.01; label units and underlying convention explicitly.

partialIdentification.name: TAIFEX_REPORTED_DEALER_CLASS_GAMMA_BOUND
partialIdentification.purpose: Bound dealer-class signed gamma without inventing strike-level dealer inventory.
partialIdentification.method: For each call/put side separately, allocate the published aggregate dealer-class positive-gamma and negative-gamma contract counts across strike-expiry nodes subject to each node's market OI capacity. The minimum allocates positive-gamma contracts to lowest-gamma capacity and negative-gamma contracts to highest-gamma capacity; the maximum reverses this. A linear-program implementation is preferred for exact capacity handling.

signRule.UNKNOWN: interval includes 0 or source-universe reconciliation fails

partialIdentification.namingGuard: This is a dealer-class gamma bound, not exact option-market-maker GEX.

falsificationPlan: Compare gamma-weighted concentration against OI-only concentration; if gamma weighting adds no outcome information, keep OI-only.
Test normal days separately from weekly/monthly expiry and settlement-window days.
Test scheduled macro-event days separately from ordinary days.
Test model sensitivity to IV filtering, underlying convention, rate/dividend/forward assumptions and quote-quality thresholds.
Use allocation permutations / exact bounds; if the signed interval crosses zero on most dates, signed public dealer GEX is practically unidentifiable.
Test top-gamma-node proximity against price dwell/crossing/reversal only with pre-registered windows; do not label nodes as support/resistance ex ante.
Control VIX/realized volatility, DTE, moneyness, liquidity, global shocks and Taiwan market regime.
Use independent trading dates as the inference unit; no duplicate intraday rows masquerading as independent samples.
primaryOutcomes: price dwell/crossing near gamma concentration nodes
secondaryOutcomes: stock-level outcomes only after market/sector controls

maturityDecision.reason: Mechanism, identifiability limits, source semantics and falsification design are now defined; no prospective PIT evidence has yet earned L3.
